title: The Last Gravity Revisited
author: Petra Villalobos
blurb: Isandro Sandoval, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
